---
title: "Patch supplementary figures — pathway analysis"
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

## Overview

This document composes the supplementary pathway analysis figures for the manuscript: top 2000 CpG upset plots for genes and GO terms, top 2000 function categorization barplot, and supplementary tables.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, gt, ragg, install = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-theme
#| echo: false

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load Plot Objects

Load pre-generated plot objects and tables for composition.

```{r}
#| label: load-plots

top2000_genes_upset <- read_rds(
  here("pathway_analysis/01_genes/output/top2000_all_genes_upset_plot.rds")
)

top2000_go_terms_upset <- read_rds(
  here("pathway_analysis/03_transition_specific_GO_terms/output/top2000_condition_specific_GO_terms.rds")
)

top2000_function_categorization <- read_rds(
  here("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output/top2000_barplot_function_category.rds")
)

top1000_gt_tables <- read_rds(
  here("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output/top1000_condition_specific_GO_terms_gt_tables.rds")
)
```

## Supplementary Upset Figure

Compose top 2000 gene and GO term upset plots into a single stacked figure.

```{r}
#| label: modify-upset-plots

panel_a <- top2000_genes_upset + theme_main_fig()
panel_b <- top2000_go_terms_upset + theme_main_fig()
```

```{r}
#| label: compose-upset-figure

fig_sup_upset <- panel_a + panel_b +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "keep", axes = "keep", axis_titles = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```

```{r}
#| label: save-upset-figure
fs::dir_create(here("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output"))

agg_png(
  here("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output/fig_sup_upset_top2000_genes_and_GO_terms.png"),
  width = 7.5, height = 9, units = "in", res = 600
)
print(fig_sup_upset)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: display-upset-figure
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

fig_sup_upset
```

## Supplementary Barplot Figure

Top 2000 CpG function categorization barplot.

```{r}
#| label: compose-barplot-figure

fig_sup_barplot <- top2000_function_categorization +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_markdown(angle = 15)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: save-barplot-figure

agg_png(
  here("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output/fig_sup_barplot_top2000_function_categorization.png"),
  width = 6.5, height = 8, units = "in", res = 600
)
print(fig_sup_barplot)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: display-barplot-figure
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

fig_sup_barplot
```

## Supplementary Tables

Export gt tables as PNG images.

```{r}
#| label: save-tables

top1000_gt_tables |>
  purrr::iwalk(~gtsave(.x, here(glue("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output/top1000_{.y}_supplementary_table.png")), zoom = 2, expand = 10))
```

## Verify Output

Confirm all output files were created successfully.

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- c(
  here("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output/fig_sup_upset_top2000_genes_and_GO_terms.png"),
  here("pathway_analysis/05_patch_fig_and_make_table/output/fig_sup_barplot_top2000_function_categorization.png")
)

for (f in output_files) {
  file_info <- fs::file_info(f)
  cat("Output file:", f, "\n")
  cat("File size:", format(file_info$size, units = "MB"), "\n")
  cat("Created:", as.character(file_info$modification_time), "\n\n")
}
```
